slides.title: Nothing ships without me.

loop.lede: The traditional lifecycle is a line — plan, design, build, test, deploy, maintain — and one slow loop back is a new release. I run it as a continuous loop. Code is no longer the bottleneck; the human-speed steps around it are. So agents do the hands-on work in hours, and I put my attention where judgement is needed: deciding, reviewing, approving.

stages.name: Plan
stages.agents: turn your idea into a written intent: problem, outcome, affected systems, constraints, acceptance criteria.
stages.me: Instigate — nothing enters the loop until I've written it down with you.

stages.name: Design
stages.agents: draft the architecture, the diagrams and the risk list against the spec, with your standards applied up front.
stages.me: Direct — I make the trade-offs: stack, boundaries, security, cost.

stages.name: Build
stages.agents: implement each unit in parallel, on its own branch, from a written plan I've approved.
stages.me: Direct — I keep the conventions the agents read every session, and I review the diffs.

stages.name: Test
stages.agents: verify their own work before anyone sees it: builds pass, tests pass, screenshots match the design.
stages.me: Govern — I decide what green means; what reaches me has already passed the checks.

stages.name: Deploy
stages.agents: run review passes against spec and policy, then ship through one pipeline.
stages.me: Govern — the agent that wrote the code can't approve it. I do, at the gate.

stages.name: Maintain
stages.agents: watch production, diagnose what drifts and feed findings back in as new intent.
stages.me: Instigate — I triage, approve the fix, and the loop starts again.

roles.name: Instigate
roles.text: I start the work — the intent, the spec, the plan — so what enters the loop is what you actually need.

roles.name: Direct
roles.text: I steer several agent sessions at once and judge the risk at every stage gate.

roles.name: Govern
roles.text: I encode quality, security and cost as rules the agents can't skip, so they hold every session, every time.

loop.outro: ↻ Maintain feeds Plan. The loop keeps running; my judgement stays above it. Solo, or leading a small team — whichever the problem needs.

contact.lede: I help clients turn an idea into working software — solution architecture, cloud, delivery and AI integration — as a solo architect or leading a small team. Da Nang, Vietnam · remote or on site.
